title: TransHands: Repurposing Human Pose Encoders as Hand Pose Encoders
abstract: arXiv:2608.22341v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Lifting 3D hand poses from 2D monocular representations remains challenging due to the limited availability of large-scale, diverse 3D-annotated hand datasets, in contrast to the abundance of human body motion data. We address this limitation by transferring motion representations learned from large body pose corpora to the hand domain. We introduce TransHands, a backbone-agnostic transfer learning framework that enables pre-trained human motion encoders to be effectively adapted for 3D hand pose estimation from 2D pose inputs. Rather than training hand-specific biomechanical models from scratch, TransHands combines a two-stage training and fine-tuning strategy with a lightweight hand-specific input adaptation module that aligns hand kinematics with the representation space learned for full-body motion. translated_title: TransHands：将人体姿态编码器改造为手部姿态编码器
translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.22341v1 公告类型：交叉 摘要：从二维单目表示中提升三维手部姿态仍然具有挑战性，原因是大规模、多样化的三维标注手部数据集的可用性有限，而人体运动数据则相对丰富。我们通过将大型人体姿态语料库中学到的运动表示迁移到手部领域来解决这一限制。我们引入了TransHands，这是一个与骨干网络无关的迁移学习框架，使预训练的人体运动编码器能够有效地适应于从二维姿态输入进行三维手部姿态估计。TransHands不是从头训练特定于手的生物力学模型，而是结合了两阶段训练和微调策略，以及一个轻量级的手部特定输入适应模块，该模块将手部运动学与全身运动学学习到的表示空间对齐。我们在四种最先进的运动建模架构上评估了TransHands，包括基于变换器、基于图以及基于频率的架构。
tldr: TransHands提出了一种迁移学习框架，通过轻量级适应模块将预训练的人体运动编码器有效改造为手部姿态编码器，从而在有限手部数据下实现高效的三维手部姿态估计。
en_tdlr: TransHands introduces a transfer learning framework that repurposes pre-trained human motion encoders as effective hand pose encoders via a lightweight adaptation module, enabling efficient 3D hand pose estimation with limited hand-specific data.
